up: Retrieve the first 200 metabolism records for the enzyme CYP2C9. Filter the metabolism table by enzyme_name = 'CYP2C9'. Join compound_records on substrate_record_id to obtain the substrate compound name. Join compound_structures on molregno to obtain the substrate canonical SMILES. Output columns: canonical_smiles, compound_name, met_conversion, pathway_key, organism. Limit the result to 200 rows.
sql: SELECT cs.canonical_smiles, cr.compound_name, m.met_conversion, m.pathway_key, m.organism FROM metabolism m JOIN compound_records cr ON m.substrate_record_id = cr.record_id JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE m.enzyme_name = 'CYP2C9' LIMIT 200
